newsitem.title: JAPAN: Racketeer admits illicit deals with Yamaichi - paper.
newsitem.headline: Racketeer admits illicit deals with Yamaichi - paper.

text.p: Corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike has told prosecutors that Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd conducted illegal stock operations on his account, the Japanese daily Yomiuri Shimbun's wire service said on Monday.

The wire service quoted Koike's laywer as saying Koike has admitted that Nikko Securities Co Ltd and Daiwa Securities Co Ltd also made discretionary stock deals for an account held in his brother's company's name.
Discretionary deals by brokerages for their customers are banned by the Securities Law as they can be used by brokers to illegally compensate their clients for stock trade losses.
Asked for a comment on the report, a Yamaichi spokesman said: "We will not comment on deals with individual clients."
Koike is a key figure in a high-profile payoff scandal involving Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and Nomura Securities Co Ltd.
